name: Home Assistant
summary: Your home in the Nook: favorites, rooms, scenes and live state.
capabilities: Connects to your chosen Home Assistant server using its supported WebSocket API
Stores its own access token in macOS Keychain
Reads live entities, rooms, device availability and scenes
Saves favorites and individually allowed controls in plugin-owned settings
Sends reviewed light, switch and scene commands without automatic retries
Checks light and switch state after a command
Exports typed reviewed actions and fresh status through the shared SDK
